summary: Adds the same-major agent guide: install the exact target version, confirm it with next --version, verify the app, then return to shared.md for delivery. It is a draft doc that the upgrade CLI copies into the run directory and points the agent to when the major version is unchanged. It contains no executable code, and the CLI logic that selects it is in other units.
headline: New same-major agentic upgrade guide for exact-version updates
reason: New draft markdown instructions for an agent with no executable code; it steers agent behavior only on the same-major path, so a short summary suffices.
